versions.content: Reporting DTR s for unavailable events If Dem_DcmGetDTR- Data is called for an DTR that references via DemDtrEventRef an event that itself is configured with DemEventAvailable to FALSE, the Dem shall return E_NOT_OK. In this case all the out-parameters of Dem_DcmGetDTRData are undefined.
